Post Date: 2016-04-18T10:27:16Z

Title: Can I access other silos from within a silo
Description: Is it possible to access other silo's from within a silo?

My use case is this: We would like to have a silo with all of our business logic grains, and another silo with all of our database-grains. The business logic grains will of course use the database-grains. The purpose of separating the two is that we can "mock" the database grains in an automated test by simply replacing the silo with the database grains with a corresponding silo mocking the database.

Thanks
